visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are very similar, which may cause confusion.
visualRisks.details: The water color (#143950) is almost indistinguishable from the road color (#667b8a). This could lead to players missing important elements like docks or houses.

visualRisks.description: Some areas lack visual cues, making navigation difficult.
visualRisks.details: The central area of the district (rows 5-10) has no distinguishing features, which might confuse players trying to follow routes.

navigationRisks.description: Route path is not clearly defined in the grid.
navigationRisks.details: The route provided [15,27,16,28,17,40,52,41,64,42,76,54,43,88,77,55,100,89,101,90,113,91,114,103,115,104,105,93,117,106,94] does not follow a clear path and may lead to dead ends or confusion.
Cells with 'h' (water) and '.' (ground) do not allow movement, which could disrupt the player's progress if they are part of the intended route.
